full_prompt_en: A square monochrome aquatint print shows a pale long-finned fish swimming through a dark enclosed underwater scene, bordered by a wide warm-cream paper margin. The printed image is a nearly square rectangle with a clear straight edge set slightly in from the sheet. At the upper left, a large billowing light mass hangs over the water, its softly granular edges pressing against the black background. A tall delicate stem rises at the left, with a few leaves and buds picked out in silver-gray. The central water is very dark, leaving the fish as the main luminous shape just right of center. Its rounded head faces left, with a small dark eye and finely marked scales; long translucent fins trail toward the right and curl downward in layered ribbons. On the right edge, leaf-like forms and rough stone shapes frame the fish. Across the lower foreground, irregular pale wavy lines spread over a darker bed, suggesting rippled light on submerged stones. Small plants and rounded rocks cluster in the bottom left and right corners. The scene has no distant horizon; overlap and shifting values create a compact pocket of depth. The fish is seen from the side, while the viewer looks slightly down at the patterned floor. Light appears to filter from the upper left, brightening the fish, the hanging pale mass, and a moving network on the bottom; the middle background remains nearly black. Fine grain, soft tonal transitions, and etched outlines coexist across the print. The overall composition is hushed and mysterious, setting one delicate luminous form within dense dark water and softly broken light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色飞尘腐蚀版画把一尾浅色长鳍鱼置于幽暗围合的水下场景中，周围有宽阔暖奶油色纸边。印刷图像是一个离纸边稍有距离、直边清楚的近方形矩形。左上方，一团巨大的浅色翻卷形态悬在水上方，柔和颗粒边缘压向黑色背景。左侧一根纤细长茎升起，几片叶和花苞以银灰色显现。中央水域很暗，使中间偏右的鱼成为主要发光形状。圆润鱼头朝左，有小小深色眼睛和细致的鳞纹；长而半透明的鳍朝右拖曳，并以层叠带状向下卷曲。右边缘的叶形与粗糙石块框住鱼身。下方前景里，不规则的浅色波线铺在较暗底面上，像水光在水下石块上晃动。细小植物与圆石聚在左下和右下角。场景没有远方地平线；重叠与明暗变化构成紧凑的纵深空间。鱼从侧面可见，观者则略俯视带纹样的底部。光仿佛从左上方过滤而入，照亮鱼、悬浮的浅色团块及底部游动的光网；中间背景几乎保持黑色。细颗粒、柔和色调过渡与刻线轮廓在版画中共存。整体构图安静而神秘，把一件脆弱发光形体置于密集深色水域与破碎柔光之中。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome aquatint treatment uses grainy tonal fields, soft gray transitions, and selective fine etched lines. Deep charcoal occupies the center, while pale cream-white forms and scattered silver highlights emerge along an irregular diagonal. Edges range from velvety dissolves in the lighter masses to sharper incised contours around small details. One luminous central form receives attention because the surrounding values are kept dark and compact. Apparent upper-left light breaks into a patterned lower region, creating depth through mottled contrast rather than clear perspective. A straight print boundary and broad warm paper margin emphasize the image as a physical impression. The effect is delicate, atmospheric, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 单色飞尘腐蚀版画以颗粒状色调场、柔和灰阶过渡和局部精细刻线成像。深炭色占据中央，浅奶油白形态与零散银色高光沿不规则斜线浮出。边缘从亮色体块的绒雾式溶解，变化到细部周围更锋利的切刻轮廓。一个明亮中央形体得到关注，因为周围明暗保持深暗而紧凑。似从左上而来的光分解成下方纹样区域，不靠明确透视，而靠斑驳反差制造纵深。笔直的印刷边界和宽阔暖色纸边强调图像是一次实体压印。效果细腻、有空气感且含蓄戏剧化。
theme_en: A pale long-finned fish in a shadowed underwater aquatint
theme_zh: 深暗水下飞白色长鳍鱼的飞尘腐蚀版画
name: Aquatint print
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
